definition: II. צִיץ noun [masculine] meaning dubious; only in תְּנוּצִֿיץ לְמוֺאָב Jer 48:9 usually (after AW Ra Ki and others) wings (collective) (compare Aramaic צִיץ wing, fin , Thes Gf and others); ** Aramaic צִיץ wing dubious Levy 322 b ; Aramaic נוֺצִיץ very rare; but note Late Hebrew צִיץ filament, small hair . compare Perles Anal.46 , who reads נוֺצִיץ (wing-) feathers (as in Aramaic); ᵐ5 σημεῖα , whence Gie sign-post , reading צִיוּן , — or נֵס , — (indicating flight).

BDB7054 [H6731]

BDB7053 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB7055

II. צִיץ noun [masculine] meaning dubious; only in תְּנוּצִֿיץ לְמוֺאָב Jer 48:9 usually (after AW Ra Ki and others) wings (collective) (compare Aramaic צִיץ wing, fin, Thes Gf and others);

**Aramaic צִיץ wing dubious Levy322 b; Aramaic נוֺצִיץ very rare; but note Late Hebrew צִיץ filament, small hair. compare PerlesAnal.46, who reads נוֺצִיץ (wing-) feathers (as in Aramaic); ᵐ5 σημεῖα, whence Gie sign-post, reading צִיוּן, — or נֵס, — (indicating flight).
